recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast duotone portrait of a musician at a piano, featuring a split-tone grey and black palette with bold, stacked slab-serif typography occupying the right-hand negative space.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed toward the lower-left corner
Typography balanced against the subject's head in the upper-right quadrant
Horizontal piano line dividing the lower third of the composition
Tight vertical cropping on the left edge with a solid black border

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait centered horizontally but shifted left by a black vertical margin; subject occupies roughly 60% of vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's dark sunglasses and smile provide the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves right to the large display text, then down to the horizontal metadata line at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open grey space in the upper right used for primary typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Medium neutral grey background and mid-tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for shadows, piano, and left-side border.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for all typographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between white text and dark shadows.
paletteRestrictions: No gradients; use flat tones or photographic grain

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with condensed proportions.
letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight with minimal modulation
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; standard high-impact slab serif characteristics

composition.position: Lower horizontal third, centered on piano

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying scales and weights.
graphicDevices: Horizontal row of small asterisks/stars as a divider
Solid black vertical bar on the far left

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serifs and geometric construction.
Classic mid-century slab serif with similar weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy duotone photograph of a male jazz musician in a suit and sunglasses, smiling while playing a piano. Use a medium-grey background and deep black for the piano and shadows. Include a solid black vertical strip on the left edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add four lines of stacked, centered uppercase slab-serif text in white in the upper right. Place a row of small white stars between the second and third lines. Add a single line of smaller, wide-tracked slab-serif text centered across the bottom piano section.

verificationChecks: Are the serifs heavy and rectangular?
Is there a black bar on the left?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the celebrity
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is perfectly centered in its respective blocks
Verify the horizontal divider is present
Confirm the duotone palette is maintained
Check that the left black border is solid
recipe.reuseFormula: Duotone Portrait + Stacked Slab-Serif + Horizontal Metadata Line
